notes.title: Update 2021-03-13
notes.content:
The previous update available in beta is now released globally.

- When starting the game with a new profile, play a set of Tutorial levels (these levels can also be replayed later and have leaderboards, but are not meant for competing)
- Reverted the first internal level to its original (pre-tutorial) state
- Removed the display of controls when playing the first level
- Added an option to customize the behavior of the View (Minimap)
- Updated filesystem management, greatly reducing the number of disk reads and writes
- Some additional small changes and fixes

notes.title: End of 2020 update & sale
notes.content:
[h1]54 more levels[/h1]
The Stolen Internals level pack by Sla contains 54 levels that are sure to challenge you. Each of them puts a creative twist on the original Elasto Mania levels and will force you to use your brains just as much as your reflexes! This collection of levels comes with its own Achievements and Leaderboards.

[h1]Game controller support[/h1]
One of the most requested feature has been native game controller support with force feedback. So now we have added it! Feel the gentle vibration and the occasional roar of the engine right in your hands.

[h1]Better local multiplayer[/h1]
Want to play through Elasto Mania with a friend? Now you can! Local Multiplayer is now played just like Singleplayer, allowing you to unlock levels as you progress, or skip them if you can't. And with game controller support, you won't need to fight over keyboard layouts anymore.

[h1]Additional changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Moved to a modern 64-bit environment, with support for multiple rendering methods
[*]Unified resolution in menu for consistency, better selection of gameplay resolution
[*]Windowed mode support
[*]Delete player option
[*]Sound-related fixes
[/list]

The discount begins Nov 5, 2020 10:00am (Seattle time).
